notes.title: Hyper Team Recon Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2][b]HYPER TEAM RECON DEMO TIME![/b][/h2]

Hyper Team Recon has a new demo, crash landing in your library right now as part of the Steam Next Fest!

In the demo, you'll be able to:

[list]
[*] Explore the Ayall space station in Chapter 1!
[*] Travel through the frozen ice caps in Chapter 2!
[*] Dress up the alien slime gang in the Scrapbook!
[*] Take on challenges with Herb, and more!
[/list]

I'm SO EXCITED to share this slice of the game with you all, and I hope you all enjoy it!
